description: Browse a Uline catalog department, search by keyword, or fetch full product detail by item number.

categoryUrl.description: A full Uline department (`Cls_XX`), group (`Grp_XX`), or subgroup (`BL_XX`) URL — copy it straight from your browser's address bar while browsing uline.com. Crawls every product from that exact node down, without being limited to the 45 top-level departments in `productClass`.
categoryUrl.title: Category/group/subgroup URL (mode=browseByUrl)

country.description: Which localized Uline storefront to scrape. Changes the base domain, currency, and (for Mexico) language — the catalog structure and item numbers are identical across markets.
country.title: Market / country

fetchFullDetails.description: (mode=browseByCategory, browseByUrl, search) Fetch each result's own product page to add pack price, pack quantity, availability, color, dimensions, and price-valid-until date. Adds one extra request per result, so runs take longer. `productDetail` mode always includes these fields at no extra cost.
fetchFullDetails.title: Fetch full product details

itemNumbers.description: Uline item numbers, e.g. `S-4992`, or full product URLs.
itemNumbers.title: Item numbers (mode=productDetail)

keywords.description: Free-text keyword search, e.g. `corrugated boxes 12x12x12`, `packing tape 2 inch`, `nitrile gloves`. More specific phrases (including a size) return the most precise matches.
keywords.title: Search keywords (mode=search)

maxPrice.description: Drop products pricier than this (in the currency of the selected `country` market).
maxPrice.title: Max price

minPrice.description: Drop products cheaper than this (in the currency of the selected `country` market — Uline prices are rarely whole numbers, e.g. `1.18`).
minPrice.title: Min price

productClass.description: One of Uline's 45 top-level catalog departments. The actor crawls every group and subgroup under it to collect real, in-stock products with prices.
productClass.title: Catalog department (mode=browseByCategory)

title: Uline Catalog & Price Scraper Input
